reason: The README describes two tools that probe mounted infrastructure components and report per-component status plus a PASS/WARN readiness verdict, making monitoring the primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 用于探测已挂载智能体基础设施组件的状态，并输出逐项检查结果与整体就绪判定。
summaries.en: Probes mounted agent-infrastructure components and reports per-component status with an overall readiness verdict.

capabilities: Probes infrastructure component availability and status
Reads readiness-related information from memory, sibling tools, skill catalogs, agents, and sessions
Reports a PASS or WARN bootstrap verdict
